[Benzinga news, 2026-11-02T13:02:15Z, by staff] Marvell Technology to Acquire Lumentum in $115 Billion All-Stock Merger
Marvell Technology and Lumentum Holdings Inc. have entered into a definitive agreement to merge in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $115 billion.
Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum stock they own, representing a premium of approximately 23.9%. The deal, which has been unanimously approved by the boards of both companies, aims to create a leader in artificial intelligence connectivity. Upon completion, Marvell shareholders are expected to own approximately 67% of the combined entity, while Lumentum shareholders will own about 33% on a fully diluted basis. The transaction is valued at $115 billion, including debt.

memos_so_far.headline: Marvell will buy Lumentum in a $115B all-stock deal, 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share
reasoning: Source: the companies' joint announcement (Dow Jones via Morningstar; Benzinga 08:02 ET): 'Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum stock ... a premium of approximately 23.9% ... unanimously approved by the boards'. Lumentum holders get about 33% of the combined company. Lumentum was halted at 06:57 ET and quoted again from 07:25.
What changed: Lumentum stops being an independent optical-component company. Its value is now tied to Marvell's share price.

Pre-market on the consolidated tape: LITE 783.52, -6.8% from 840.81, on 778,275 shares; MRVL 189.01, -3.8% from 196.40, on 2.87M shares. At 4.5 x 189.01 the deal is worth 850.55 a Lumentum share, so LITE trades 7.9% below it. Both fell sharply on Friday (LITE -8.6%, MRVL -10%) before the announcement.
objections: Friday's falls in both names before the announcement are unexplained.
